content:
Trofeum Ligi Mistrzów EPA-EFE/JEAN-CHRISTOPHE BOTT Blog na żywo Football Italia Dołącz do nas i zobacz wszystkie przygotowania i akcje rozgrywane w Lidze Mistrzów, gdy Roma odwiedzi Paris Saint-Germain Luisa Enrique, a Inter będzie gospodarzem VfB Stuttgart.

Giallorossi zaliczyli dobre występy, ale brak doświadczenia pokazał, kiedy tracili prowadzenie w meczach z Realem Madryt i Manchesterem United.

Ponownie łączą siły z Luisem Enrique, który był trenerem Romy w sezonie 2011/2012 i bez problemu zdobył dwa ostatnie trofea Ligi Mistrzów.

Inter ma jeden punkt straty do Stuttgartu przed dzisiejszym starciem, więc jest to mecz, który trzeba wygrać, aby wspiąć się w tabeli po przegranych pierwszych dwóch i wygraniu dwóch kolejnych.

Rzut rożny dla Interu, wykorzystany przez Bissecka i Akanjiego, po prostu nie trafia w tylny słupek!

content:
Bayern Munich are looking to shift the mood around the club in northern France, as they take on Lille in the Champions League.

Der Rekordmeister sit second in the Bundesliga and are yet to lose in any competition this term, yet the atmosphere is one of tension after injuries to Harry Kane, Michael Olise and more, with the former set for a three-month spell on the sidelines.

As they look to get back to winning ways after Friday's draw with Köln, they take on a Lille side sitting third in Ligue 1, who are licking their wounds after a 1-0 defeat against Lyon at the weekend.

Rossoneri patron Gerry Cardinale has made no secret of the fact he wants to bring in Endrick, repeatedly praising the youngster in the media.

Considering the lack of playing time he is getting at Real Madrid, the club is more than open to the potential exit, having invested €47.5m in buying him from Palmeiras in the summer of 2024.

title: „Najlepszy pomocnik świata” – na którym miejscu plasuje się Bellingham?
summary: Według Jose Mourinho nie. Menedżer Realu Madryt mógł próbować zarządzać minutami Anglika, ale nie powstrzymywał się od pochwał, gdy 23-latek wszedł z ławki i strzelił fenomenalnego woleja, pomagając Realowi odr
content:
Według Jose Mourinho nie.

Menedżer Realu Madryt mógł próbować zarządzać minutami Anglika, ale nie powstrzymywał się od pochwał, gdy 23-latek wszedł z ławki i strzelił fenomenalnego woleja, pomagając Realowi odrobić stratę do przerwy i pokonać PSV Eindhoven 5:1.

„Ma fizyczność, technikę, taktyczne zrozumienie gry, ma ambicje, ma absolutnie wszystko” – powiedział Mourinho.

„To absolutnie niezwykły zawodnik i dla mnie bez wątpienia najlepszy pomocnik na świecie”.

Imponujący 45-minutowy epizod Bellinghama miał miejsce zaledwie dziewięć dni po znakomitym, pełnym akcji występie dla Anglii w wygranym 3:2 Lidze Narodów w Hiszpanii.

content:

Sterling, który opuścił sąd bez komentarza, otrzymał nakaz odbycia 100 godzin bezpłatnej pracy i zakaz prowadzenia pojazdów na 24 miesiące.

content:
Raheem Sterling pleaded guilty at Basingstoke Magistrates' Court in September and admitted possession of six nitrous oxide cannisters for wrongful inhalation and failing to provide a specimen Former England player Raheem Sterling has been given a suspended 12-month jail sentence for dangerous driving and possession of nitrous oxide after a crash involving a Lamborghini on the motorway.

Sterling pleaded guilty at Basingstoke Magistrates' Court in September to driving a Lamborghini Urus dangerously on the M25, the M3, the A327 and Minley Road before he crashed on May 28.

The sentence is suspended for 18 months.

He has also been handed a two-year driving ban and must undertake 100 hours of unpaid community work.

Sterling will have to re-take a driving test to hold a licence.

content:
Werder Bremen have already made it clear that they would like to keep Niclas Füllkrug beyond the end of his loan spell from West Ham, which expires at the end of the season.

The biggest obstacle is likely to be reaching an agreement with West Ham over the transfer fee, but Werder would naturally also need to find common ground with the striker himself.

According to Sport Bild, one of the 34-year-old striker's key demands is a contract running until at least the summer of 2029.

Despite his advancing age, Werder don't see this as a major risk.

title: Why the Allianz Arena will be illuminated in orange on Wednesday
summary: As in previous years, Bayern Munich are marking the International Day for the Elimination of Violence Against Women and showing their support for the “Zonta Says No” initiative by illuminating the Allianz Arena
content:
As in previous years, Bayern Munich are marking the International Day for the Elimination of Violence Against Women and showing their support for the “Zonta Says No” initiative by illuminating the Allianz Arena in orange on Wednesday, November 25.

This year, Zonta is focusing on digital violence, from threats and cyberstalking to sexually explicit images generated and shared using AI.

“Behind threats, cyberstalking and the distribution of sexually explicit images are real people – and these actions have real consequences," said FC Bayern president Herbert Hainer.

"As FC Bayern, we do not want to turn a blind eye.

Instead, we want to take a stand and help empower those affected.

title: Werder make stance clear on Niclas Füllkrug ahead of January window amid Bayern links
summary: Topping the Bundesliga scoring charts with 10 goals, Niclas Füllkrug has been a big hit since returning to Werder Bremen on loan from West Ham United last summer. The 33-year-old's impressive form has led to sp
content:
Topping the Bundesliga scoring charts with 10 goals, Niclas Füllkrug has been a big hit since returning to Werder Bremen on loan from West Ham United last summer.

The 33-year-old's impressive form has led to speculation that his loan spell could be cut short in January to allow him to join an even bigger club, with Bayern Munich, for example, reportedly considering signing a new striker following Harry Kane's long-term injury.

Unsurprisingly, however, Werder Bremen are reluctant to let their top scorer leave when the winter transfer window opens.

“Niclas leaving in the winter is not up for discussion for us,” Werder Bremen head of first team football Peter Niemeyer told DeichStube.

Werder have already made it clear that they would like to sign Füllkrug on a permanent basis at the end of the season, but whether they will be able to do so depends on West Ham and the financial terms of a potential deal.

title: TSG Hoffenheim vs. Sturm Graz preview: Team news and predicted lineups
summary: TSG Hoffenheim and Sturm Graz will hope to make huge strides in the Europa League when they meet at SNP Arena on Thursday. Both teams only have four points each after the first four rounds of actions in the com
content:
TSG Hoffenheim and Sturm Graz will hope to make huge strides in the Europa League when they meet at SNP Arena on Thursday.

Both teams only have four points each after the first four rounds of actions in the competition.

Christian Ilzer's men recorded their points in the last two matchdays as their stunning 3-0 victory over Lyon followed by conceding a late equalizer to Conference League champions Crystal Palace in London.

Sturm Graz lost to Celje at home on matchday four.

The visitors also had a tough start to the Austrian Bundesliga season as they trail surprise league leaders SK Rapid by a staggering 15 points after only 13 rounds.
